board.name: Blazin' Boards meat board
board.traits: the wooden board with its metal ring and the burned-in 'BLAZIN' BOARDS' label, as large and sharp as in the photo; the bone-in steak in the middle; the sliced meats, red cured pieces, dark jerky and pink ham in their exact places.
board.source: a crop of their own photo (scrollcraft/builds/blazin-boards/RULES.md:43, gen/board-brief.md:6,9); the generated label came out small and soft (board-brief.md:19). assets/board-hero.webp is generated.
